method: Actual game logic, seeded reward-seeking controller, normal HP, no forced equipment or invulnerability. Policy labels describe reward preferences; random offers can prevent a completed build. 180-second cap is right censoring, not a survival estimate.
auditNote: 350-run strategy batch at intermediate combat revision 593afcb. Original baseline means stationary/skip drafts; 16 of 50 runs incidentally collected weapons and is not the strict no-upgrade baseline. Strict no-pickup 50-run baseline and final-revision policy smoke are separate files. Later fixes retain saturated enemies and increase owl III range; this earlier batch was not rerun for every seed after those changes.
